user_goal.text: Complete every task in the Camping Trip Planning Todoist project and mark them all complete.

checked_by.text: The official AppWorld evaluator and TestTracker compare the submitted answer and start/end model state; native success requires all 24 registered tests to pass.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained submitted answer and official evaluator comparison result
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained evaluator result show that the registered answer-comparison test passed?

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained start/end database diff and official TestTracker results
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the retained diff and results show that every registered model-change and state-value test passed?

undecided_if.text: Undecided only if retained evidence cannot determine one or more frozen registered-test outcomes.
undecided_if.rationale: A registered-test outcome must not be inferred when its decisive retained evidence is missing or non-decisive.

additional_conditions.text: Beyond native scoring, retained state must show that every trip mate identified by the camping project received a Todoist project invitation.
additional_conditions.rationale: The project task explicitly requires inviting the trip mates, while the native evaluator requires a ProjectInvite model change but does not verify its recipients.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained final Todoist project invitation records and camping-project participant details
decisive_artifacts.question: Do the invitation recipients include every trip mate identified by the camping project?

additional_conditions.text: Beyond native scoring, retained state must show that the Amazon order receipt is attached to the created Splitwise expense.
additional_conditions.rationale: The project task explicitly requires attaching the receipt, while the native evaluator checks changed-model membership and expense/share fields without checking a receipt-to-expense attachment.

decisive_artifacts.artifact: Retained created Splitwise expense and its attachment or receipt-link metadata
decisive_artifacts.question: Does the retained expense state show the Amazon order receipt attached to that expense?
